name: Agent Status Pill
description: A compact agent status for headers and lists: idle, running with a live clock, needs you, failed, done. The width springs between states; a click opens recent activity.

props.name: state
props.description: What the agent is doing. The label cross-fades and the pill animates to its new width when it changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Replaces the built-in label for every state (e.g. "Awaiting review"). Leave empty for Idle, Running, Needs you, Failed and Done.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Show the clock after a hairline: run time while running, time spent waiting, and the frozen run time on error and done.

props.name: since
props.description: Epoch ms the clock counts from.

props.name: until
props.description: Epoch ms the clock stopped at. Leave undefined to keep it ticking.

props.name: size
props.description: 24px for list rows, 30px for headers. Both keep a 44px touch target.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the pill sits on; sets ink, rings and the panel.

props.name: agent
props.description: Whose status this is. Prefixes the screen reader announcement and names the activity panel.

props.name: heading
props.description: Activity panel title. Defaults to a sentence for the state, such as "Waiting for your input".

props.name: summary
props.description: One or two lines under the heading.

props.name: command
props.description: A command or path the state is about, set in mono in a recessed well.

props.name: activity
props.type: { id: string; text: string; time?: string; live?: boolean }[]
props.description: The last few steps, oldest first. The live step is drawn in full ink.

props.name: actions
props.type: { label: string; onSelect: () => void; primary?: boolean }[]
props.description: Buttons at the foot of the panel, such as Approve or Retry. Selecting one closes the panel.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the pill the panel lines up with.

props.name: side
props.description: Open the panel below or above the pill.

props.name: tones
props.description: Override a state's colour. Waiting #f5a524, error #f2555a, done #3fcf8e, idle #71717a; running uses the ink.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper span. Other span attributes (data-*, aria-*) pass through too.
